gaps.title: User governance and history screens
gaps.remaining: Privacy/user/cancel/supplier agreement content and the old three-link index have local public read-only candidates. Old payVip now uses a separate membership agreement rather than the user agreement alias; the public endpoint and page accept disabled records as old PHP did, while the membership home hides them. Account cancellation write and member QR/scan/cashier consumption still lack complete target contracts; deleted-user login and auth are blocked locally. Visit history has authenticated list/delete/favourite contracts, a paginated empty-state hot feed, branding/labels and distinct advertised level/SVIP prices. Versioned metadata resolves seckill/bargain/combination IDs and presale base-product details; expired, mismatched or malformed targets fail closed. Promotion frames, full activity-flow parity, native-device and deployed real-user acceptance remain open.

gaps.title: Distributor and agent self-service
gaps.remaining: Five original paths are directly registered with distinct promoter and division applications, current-status/record reads and owner-scoped staff operations. Purpose-bound one-time SMS replaces the incompatible old code cache. This code scope was merged through PR #11 after its exact-head Linux CI passed, as recorded in MIGRATION_CHECKLIST.md. Real role/data, native devices, old-client in-place upgrades and release acceptance remain under FE-003J/K; the merged code has not been deployed.

gaps.title: Presale, newcomer, live and ranking activities
gaps.remaining: Presale has local PC/UniApp catalogues, base-SKU type-6 purchase and deferred-fulfillment candidates, while cumulative limits remain closed. Newcomer has a directly registered authenticated read-only gift/list/detail path with exact legacy type routing; type-7 activity SKU purchase and checkout are not connected. Live list and product ranking old routes are directly registered local read-only candidates; ranking now has validated current-page activity IDs and expiry. Real login, operational content, WeChat live-player plugin, native devices and release acceptance remain open; route registration alone does not close FE-003D.

gaps.title: Payment callback, generic webview and membership/payment history
gaps.remaining: Offline pay/result now have directly registered pages; registration is not provider-payment acceptance. Payment callbacks and the remaining historical deep links still require real H5/mini-program E2E. The unrestricted legacy webview remains retired pending an allowlist design.

gaps.title: Feedback, enterprise work mode and behalf ordering
gaps.remaining: All five original behalf routes are directly registered: records, buyer selection, product/cart, confirm and cashier; a new read-only detail route was not an original PHP manifest route. Registration and local synthetic tests do not establish full PHP flow parity. Confirm has scoped quote/create, delivery, candidate coupons, points, authoritative form components, private image upload/preview and an operator-disclosed submission journal. Detail/list are creating-Admin-scoped minimal projections. Cashier requires explicit payment initiation, status/detail checks and a displayed expected amount; zero-price assisted orders require confirmation without QR, and external QR is drawn locally. Cash/zero lock-time amount validation passed native PG16 flow 39/39; a later native PG16 flow 43/43 added a persistent one-time provider intent before external contact. Uncommitted callback-first evidence, unknown outcomes, real callback, authenticated device and retry acceptance remain release blockers. Public list requests without unique paging=cursor now receive an upgrade error; this does not force-upgrade the online old mini-program and App. Owner confirms existing users, but published package identity, signing, version and actual API origin are unverified. Category/advanced filters, large-catalog paging, keyword/status query plans, fresh buyer selection, unused-image lifecycle, cross-tab coordination and real Admin/Redis/Hyperdrive acceptance remain open. Feedback and five Work pages now have local route consumers. Work tokens stay separate from shopper login and in memory. No-hint entry and product send check the current SDK target; background/pagehide clear private state. A visible page with a userid hint cannot guarantee immediate clearing on an otherwise unobserved chat switch. Real Enterprise WeChat SDK/employee authorization, authenticated feedback submission, native devices and deployment are not verified.

gaps.title: Community topic, search and video deep links
gaps.remaining: The three logical legacy routes now preserve topic id/hot-new order, search keyword/topic filters, and video id/author/content-type state with pagination, retry and stale-response guards. The old APP-PLUS /app web-view URL extracts only validated page state, never loads the embedded host or token; generic unrestricted web-view behavior remains retired under FE-003F. Topic publishing and post detail are available within the deep-link page. Local preview video has no playable media, so real media playback and native-device/production acceptance remain under FE-003J/K.
